Welcome! Imagine for a moment—what truly separates a team that’s just getting by from one that’s absolutely thriving? More often than not, it comes down to the everyday habits and mindset of its leader. As we step into this journey together, inspired by Raymond Wheeler’s book, Lift: Five Practices Great Managers Do Consistently, we’ll discover how outstanding managers don’t just manage—they elevate their teams. It’s not about some secret talent or a rare gift. Instead, it’s all about simple, intentional practices that anyone can develop. These five core habits, which we’re about to uncover, aren’t just theories—they’re real, practical steps you can start using right away to build trust, boost engagement, and spark real growth.
Together, we’ll see how consistency—those small, steady actions—can make a world of difference. Whether you’re aiming to inspire, motivate, or empower your team, these insights will help you create an environment where people don’t just meet expectations; they exceed them.
So, if you’re ready to explore what it takes to become a truly great manager, and to lead a team that feels fulfilled and high-performing, let’s dive in.
